voiceSummary: AION-TECH SOLUTIONS LIMITED approved standalone and consolidated unaudited financial results for the quarter and half year ended 30 September 2026. The company reported revenue from operations of 244.73 million for the quarter ended 30 September 2026, compared to 204.27 million in the same period last year. Profit after tax was 2.42 million for the quarter, versus 2.89 million previously. For the half year, revenue was 393.85 million, and profit after tax was 108.64 million. The board also approved an investment of Rs.1,00,00,000 in GTL AION IT SOLUTIONS L.L.C., UAE. The company closed a Rs.60 million overdraft facility with Union Bank of India and availed a Rs.100.00 million overdraft from ICICI Bank. Arbitration was invoked regarding a claim of Rs.27,02,686 against Equitas Small Finance Bank Limited.

attchmntText: AION-TECH SOLUTIONS LIMITED has submitted to the Exchange, the financial results for the period ended September 30, 2026.
voiceSummary: AION-TECH SOLUTIONS LIMITED approved standalone and consolidated unaudited financial results for the quarter and half year ended 30 September 2026. The Board approved an investment of Rs.1,00,00,000 in GTL AION IT SOLUTIONS L.L.C., UAE. For the half year ended 30 September 2026, revenue from operations was Rs.393.85 million, compared to Rs.362.39 million in the previous year. Profit after tax stood at Rs.108.64 million versus a loss of Rs.1.10 million previously. Earnings per share were Rs.2.25 compared to Rs.0.02. The company invested in its wholly owned subsidiary and closed a Rs.60 million overdraft facility with Union Bank of India, retaining a Rs.100 million facility with ICICI Bank. Arbitration was invoked regarding a claim of Rs.2.71 million against Equitas Small Finance Bank Limited.
